newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says to end 1997 jobless total below 2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Spain says to end 1997 jobless total below 2 mln.

text.p: The Spanish government reiterated on Friday it expected employment to rise this year, saying the jobless total could fall below two million by year-end.

"The government hopes to end this year with the number of jobless below two million, a number we have not seen since 1979," government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez told a press conference after today's cabinet meeting.
In May the number of unemployed stood at 2.12 million while at the end of December it was 2.21 million.
The Spanish government has been forecasting around 250,000 new jobs would be created this year.
Rodriguez added that next week the release of June jobs data should show a monthly increase of above the average rate seen in previous years.
